title: Towards a Shared Rubric for Dataset Annotation
reasoning: The paper proposes a rubric for evaluating dataset annotation providers, and a significant portion of this rubric is dedicated to assessing ethical practices. It includes major categories such as 'Ethical treatment of annotators' (covering payment and work conditions) and 'Acquiring Unlabeled Data: Ethics'. This makes the evaluation of ethics a core component of the proposed framework, not just a brief, peripheral 'Ethical Considerations' section.
